title: Bad Casette - Resourcepack
description: Adds a Bad Piggies cassette tape to Minecraft Vista Mod
body:
Adds a Bad Piggies cassette tape to the Minecraft Vista Mod, letting you play Bad Piggies music on your in-game TV! (Resource Pack Version)

Requires 

- [Bad Piggies Cassette Tape (Datapack)](https://modrinth.com/project/Ctrf5uCx)


- [Vista Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vista_tv)
